whispers.title: Your mother, at the door
whispers.script:
[cast: left=mrs_frost]
Mrs-Frost: There you are. The Bingleys' carriage has been past twice this morning, and you are still not dressed for anything.
Arabella: I am dressed for reading, Mama. It is a costume like any other.
Mrs-Frost: Netherfield gives a ball tonight. The whole county will be there — and, I am told, a gentleman with ten thousand a year who has not yet learned to be bored.
Arabella: Then I shall go and teach him.
Mrs-Frost: Go and be seen, child. The rest will follow.

whispers.title: The morning after
whispers.script:
(Situation: w_after_ball | The morning after | Charlotte on the lane)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Oo Lucas falls in beside you with the air of a woman about to be useful.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=arabella_frost right=charlotte_lucas]
Charlotte-Lucas: Well. The whole county saw you last night. If it is gossip you want, the high street is a crush by noon.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: I have gossip enough at home, thank you. [trait: Reserved]
Arabella: Gossip — or company? [trait: Curious]
(IfChoice:0)
Charlotte-Lucas: Then come to Lucas Lodge. Quieter — and my father wants the story from you, not the street.
Mechanics: (Relation: charlotte_lucas | trust | +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Charlotte-Lucas: If it is a husband you want, there is no better place for new faces. Half the regiment buys its gloves there. But start with us — Lucas Lodge, before noon.
Mechanics: (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
